notes.title: Exciting New Features and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you all for your invaluable feedback. Here’s what’s new in this new build:

Major Updates

Dagger Stone Plate Power-Up

 Based on your feedback, I’ve added the Dagger Stone Plate, a powerful new feature that can be generated by consecutively bursting bubbles. The number of bubbles this power-up can burst is exactly equal to the number of daggers it accumulates. Equip it to your shooter and strategically use it to clear the arena more effectively. Mastering this power-up can significantly ease your gameplay.


Automatic Color Refresh for Ready-to-Shoot Bubbles:

 Based on your feedback, the color of the next bubble ready to shoot will now automatically refresh to a color that matches colors on the gameplay arena, if its current color no longer exists.


Immediate Score Feedback

 Now, see the score you earn immediately after each bubble burst. This addition aims to provide instant feedback on your performance, keeping you informed and engaged as you aim for higher final scores.


Bug Fixes

Enhanced Bubble Generation

 Fixed an issue with random bubble generation at the beginning of each round.


Scroll Icon Offset Correction

 Adjusted the scroll icon offset to ensure perfect alignment.

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 21
notes.content:
Typo Correction: Corrected a typo in the name "Guojie" in the Traditional Chinese version.
 Extended Ray Length: The ray's length has been increased.
 Crash Fix: Identified and resolved a bug that was causing the game to crash.

notes.title: Improvements Based on the Feedback
notes.content:
Thank you for player's feedback! This update includes several enhancements to improve your gaming experience:


 Color Swapping: Now press the Shift key to swap colors between the current and next bubble.
 Bubble Refresh: At each round's start, bubbles will refresh to match existing gameplay arena colors.
 Accurate Ray Path: Updated the ray path visualization for precise shot planning and execution.
 Language Preference: The game now sets the default language to match your system settings from the first run.
